title: NBI seizes over P3 million worth of counterfeit DBTK apparel in Pasay, Antipolo raids
summary: The NBI seized nearly 3,000 pieces of counterfeit apparel bearing the trademark of local streetwear brand Don’t Blame the Kids (DBTK), with an estimated value of more than P3 million.
